newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bans firing for 45 days.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bans firing for 45 days.

text.p: The Venezuelan government has placed a 45 day ban on job dismissals while a recent agreement on severance pay is made law, Labor Minister Maria Bernardoni said.

"We decided to do this ... during the transition period while the necessary legal changes are being made to the severance pay laws," Bernardoni told reporters after the weekly cabinet meeting with President Rafael Caldera.
Venezuela signed an historic severance pay and social security reform agreement Monday, which is expected to be passed relatively quickly by Congress.
The firing ban follows concern from some sectors that businesses may use the intervening period to fire workers before the new regulations come into place.
"We simply want to maintain the sense of harmony that justified and helped bring about such a great, transcendental, change in Venezuelan labor and social security laws," Bernardoni said.
